<script>
    let dadosPreProdBrutos = [];
    let dadosAtivosPre = []; 
    let dadosFiltradosPre = [];
    let graficosAtivosPre = {}; 
    let visaoAtualPre = 'wip'; 

    // 1. INCLUSÃO DO CAMPO NOVO NOS MATRICIAIS DE FILTRO
    const camposFiltro = ["statusAtual", "un", "ciclo", "envio", "pr", "indexTiragem", "segmento", "serie", "tipo", "grafica", "periodo"];
    const cfgFiltrosPre = [
        { id: "f_periodo", campo: "periodo", label: "PERÍODO (ANO.T)" }, // Novo filtro no início
        { id: "f_status", campo: "statusAtual", label: "STATUS GERAL" },
        { id: "f_un", campo: "un", label: "UN" },
        { id: "f_grafica", campo: "grafica", label: "GRÁFICA" },
        { id: "f_ciclo", campo: "ciclo", label: "CICLO" },
        { id: "f_envio", campo: "envio", label: "ENVIO" },
        { id: "f_pr", campo: "pr", label: "P/R" },
        { id: "f_index", campo: "indexTiragem", label: "INDEX" },
        { id: "f_segmento", campo: "segmento", label: "SEGMENTO" },
        { id: "f_serie", campo: "serie", label: "SÉRIE" },
        { id: "f_tipo", campo: "tipo", label: "TIPO" }
    ];

    let selecoesFiltrosPre = {};
    window.opcoesFiltrosPre = {}; 
    window.dropdownAbertoPre = null; 
    camposFiltro.forEach(c => selecoesFiltrosPre[c] = (c === 'envio' ? ['V1'] : []));

    window.chamarTelaPreProd = function(visao) {
        visaoAtualPre = visao;
        if (!dadosPreProdBrutos || dadosPreProdBrutos.length === 0) recarregarDadosPreProd(visao, false);
        else alternarVisaoPreProd(visao);
    };

    function recarregarDadosPreProd(visaoAlvo = visaoAtualPre, silencioso = false) {
        if(!silencioso) {
            if(window.setLoading) window.setLoading(true, "Carregando Pré-Produção...");
            let loaderLocal = document.getElementById('loadingPreProd');
            if(loaderLocal) {
                loaderLocal.classList.remove('hidden');
                loaderLocal.classList.add('flex');
            }
            let ctPrin = document.getElementById('conteinerPrincipalPre');
            if(ctPrin) ctPrin.classList.add('hidden');
        }

        google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(function(dadosNovos) { try { if(typeof dadosNovos === "string" && (dadosNovos.trim().startsWith("[") || dadosNovos.trim().startsWith("{"))) dadosNovos = JSON.parse(dadosNovos); if(typeof dadosNovos === "string") dadosNovos = JSON.parse(dadosNovos); } catch(e){} 
            if(!silencioso) {
                if(window.setLoading) window.setLoading(false);
                let loaderLocal = document.getElementById('loadingPreProd');
                if(loaderLocal) {
                    loaderLocal.classList.add('hidden');
                    loaderLocal.classList.remove('flex');
                }
                let ctPrin = document.getElementById('conteinerPrincipalPre');
                if(ctPrin) ctPrin.classList.remove('hidden');
            }

            if (!dadosNovos || dadosNovos.length === 0 || dadosNovos[0].erro) {
                if(!silencioso) alert("Erro ao buscar base ou base vazia.");
                return;
            }

            dadosPreProdBrutos = dadosNovos.map(item => {
                camposFiltro.forEach(f => { if(f !== 'statusAtual' && item[f]) item[f] = String(item[f]).trim().toUpperCase(); });
                item.paginas = window.arredondar(item.paginas);
                return processarDatasPreProd(item);
            });

            if(!silencioso) {
                alternarVisaoPreProd(visaoAlvo);
            } else {
                dadosAtivosPre = dadosPreProdBrutos;
                window.opcoesFiltrosPre = {};
            }

        }).getDadosPreProducao();
    }

    function processarDatasPreProd(item) {
        let hoje = new Date(); hoje.setHours(0,0,0,0);
        function getStatus(dtReal, dtPlan) {
            if (dtReal && dtReal.trim() !== "") return "CONCLUIDO";
            if (!dtPlan || dtPlan.trim() === "") return "NO_PRAZO"; 
            let p = dtPlan.split(" ")[0].split("/");
            if (p.length === 3) {
                let dPlan = new Date(p[2], p[1] - 1, p[0]); dPlan.setHours(0,0,0,0);
                if (dPlan < hoje) return "ATRASO";
                if (dPlan.getTime() === hoje.getTime()) return "HOJE";
            }
            return "NO_PRAZO";
        }
        item.stEnvio = getStatus(item.dtEnvioReal, item.dtEnvioPlan);
        item.stRec = getStatus(item.dtRecBonReal, item.dtRecBonPlan);
        item.stAprov = getStatus(item.dtApvBonReal, item.dtApvBonPlan);

        function calcDiasAtraso(dtPlan) {
            if (!dtPlan || dtPlan.trim() === "") return 0;
            let p = dtPlan.split(" ")[0].split("/");
            if (p.length === 3) {
                let dPlan = new Date(p[2], p[1] - 1, p[0]); dPlan.setHours(0,0,0,0);
                let diff = Math.floor((hoje.getTime() - dPlan.getTime()) / 86400000);
                return diff > 0 ? diff : 0;
            }
            return 0;
        }
        item.diasAtrasoEnv = item.stEnvio === 'ATRASO' ? calcDiasAtraso(item.dtEnvioPlan) : 0;
        item.diasAtrasoRec = item.stRec === 'ATRASO' ? calcDiasAtraso(item.dtRecBonPlan) : 0;
        item.diasAtrasoApv = item.stAprov === 'ATRASO' ? calcDiasAtraso(item.dtApvBonPlan) : 0;
        item.maxAtrasoDias = Math.max(item.diasAtrasoEnv, item.diasAtrasoRec, item.diasAtrasoApv);

        let s = [];
        if(item.stEnvio !== 'CONCLUIDO') s.push(item.stEnvio);
        if(item.stRec !== 'CONCLUIDO') s.push(item.stRec);
        if(item.stAprov !== 'CONCLUIDO') s.push(item.stAprov);
        if(s.includes('ATRASO')) item.statusAtual = "VENCIDO";
        else if(s.includes('HOJE')) item.statusAtual = "VENCE HOJE";
        else item.statusAtual = "NO PRAZO";

        function calcAd(real, plan) {
            if(!real || real.trim() === "") return null;
            let noPrazo = true;
            if(plan && plan.trim() !== "") {
                let p = plan.split(" ")[0].split("/"); let r = real.split(" ")[0].split("/");
                if(p.length===3 && r.length===3) {
                    let dPlan = new Date(p[2], p[1]-1, p[0]); dPlan.setHours(0,0,0,0);
                    let dReal = new Date(r[2], r[1]-1, r[0]); dReal.setHours(0,0,0,0);
                    noPrazo = dReal <= dPlan;
                }
            }
            return { data: real.split(" ")[0], noPrazo: noPrazo };
        }
        item.adEnvio = calcAd(item.dtEnvioReal, item.dtEnvioPlan);
        item.adRec = calcAd(item.dtRecBonReal, item.dtRecBonPlan);
        item.adApv = calcAd(item.dtApvBonReal, item.dtApvBonPlan);
        return item;
    }

    function alternarVisaoPreProd(visaoAlvo) {
        visaoAtualPre = visaoAlvo;
        
        let elWip = document.getElementById('visaoWIPPre');
        let elAderencia = document.getElementById('visaoAderenciaPre');
        let elResumo = document.getElementById('visaoResumo');
        let elCaixas = document.getElementById('visaoCaixasPre');
        let elTitulo = document.getElementById('tituloVisaoPreProd');
        let headerWip = document.getElementById('headerFiltrosWipPre'); 

        if(elWip) elWip.classList.add('hidden');
        if(elAderencia) elAderencia.classList.add('hidden');
        if(elResumo) elResumo.classList.add('hidden');
        if(elCaixas) elCaixas.classList.add('hidden');

        document.getElementById('conteinerPrincipalPre').classList.remove('hidden');

        let btnAtualizarTopo = document.querySelector('button[onclick^="recarregarDadosPreProd"], button[onclick^="carregarDadosCaixas"]');

        if(visaoAlvo === 'caixas') { 
            if(headerWip) headerWip.classList.add('hidden');
            if(elCaixas) elCaixas.classList.remove('hidden');
            if(elTitulo) elTitulo.innerText = '📦 Embalagens e Caixas';
            
            if(btnAtualizarTopo) btnAtualizarTopo.setAttribute("onclick", "carregarDadosCaixas(true)");

            if(!window.DADOS_CAIXAS_CACHE) window.carregarDadosCaixas();
            else window.renderTabelaCaixas();
            return; 
        }

        if(btnAtualizarTopo) btnAtualizarTopo.setAttribute("onclick", "recarregarDadosPreProd()");
        if(headerWip) headerWip.classList.remove('hidden'); 

        if(visaoAlvo === 'wip' || visaoAlvo === 'WIP') {
            if(elWip) elWip.classList.remove('hidden');
            if(elTitulo) elTitulo.innerText = '🔥 Fila de Trabalho (WIP)';
            dadosAtivosPre = dadosPreProdBrutos.filter(d => !d.dtApvBonReal || d.dtApvBonReal.trim() === "");
        } 
        else if(visaoAlvo === 'aderencia') {
            if(elAderencia) elAderencia.classList.remove('hidden');
            if(elTitulo) elTitulo.innerText = '🏆 Aderência e Produtividade';
            dadosAtivosPre = dadosPreProdBrutos; 
        }
        else if(visaoAlvo === 'resumo') {
            if(elResumo) elResumo.classList.remove('hidden');
            if(elTitulo) elTitulo.innerText = '📈 Resumo Executivo';
            dadosAtivosPre = dadosPreProdBrutos; 
        }

        desenharFiltrosInteligentes();
        aplicarFiltrosInteligentes();
    }

    function alternarDropdownPre(campoId) {
        let menuId = 'drop_pre_' + campoId;
        let menuEl = document.getElementById(menuId);
        let estaFechado = menuEl.classList.contains('hidden');

        document.querySelectorAll('.drop-menu-pre').forEach(m => m.classList.add('hidden'));

        if(estaFechado) {
            menuEl.classList.remove('hidden');
            window.dropdownAbertoPre = menuId; 
        } else {
            window.dropdownAbertoPre = null;
        }
    }

    function toggleCheckFiltroPre(campo, valor) {
        let arr = selecoesFiltrosPre[campo];
        let idx = arr.indexOf(valor);
        if(idx > -1) arr.splice(idx, 1); else arr.push(valor);
        
        window.dropdownAbertoPre = 'drop_pre_' + campo; 
        desenharFiltrosInteligentes();
        aplicarFiltrosInteligentes();
    }

    window.marcarTodosFiltro = function(campo) {
        selecoesFiltrosPre[campo] = [...window.opcoesFiltrosPre[campo]];
        window.dropdownAbertoPre = 'drop_pre_' + campo;
        desenharFiltrosInteligentes(); aplicarFiltrosInteligentes();
    }
    
    window.limparUnicoFiltro = function(campo) {
        selecoesFiltrosPre[campo] = [];
        window.dropdownAbertoPre = 'drop_pre_' + campo;
        desenharFiltrosInteligentes(); aplicarFiltrosInteligentes();
    }

    function desenharFiltrosInteligentes() {
        const container = document.getElementById('containerFiltrosPreProd');
        let html = `<div class="text-[10px] font-black text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider mr-2">Filtros:</div>`;

        cfgFiltrosPre.forEach(cfg => {
            let dadosPossiveis = dadosAtivosPre.filter(d => {
                let passa = true;
                cfgFiltrosPre.forEach(outroCfg => {
                    if (outroCfg.campo !== cfg.campo && selecoesFiltrosPre[outroCfg.campo].length > 0) {
                        if (!selecoesFiltrosPre[outroCfg.campo].includes(d[outroCfg.campo])) passa = false;
                    }
                });
                return passa;
            });

            let unicos = [...new Set(dadosPossiveis.map(item => item[cfg.campo]))].filter(v => v).sort();
            window.opcoesFiltrosPre[cfg.campo] = unicos; 
            
            let qtdSelec = selecoesFiltrosPre[cfg.campo].length;
            let corBotao = qtdSelec > 0 ? 'border-indigo-500 bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700' : 'border-slate-300 bg-white text-slate-600';
            if(cfg.campo === 'statusAtual' && qtdSelec === 0) corBotao = 'border-amber-400 bg-amber-50 text-amber-700';

            html += `
            <div class="relative inline-block text-left">
                <button onclick="alternarDropdownPre('${cfg.campo}')" class="${corBotao} border px-2 py-1.5 text-[10px] font-bold rounded shadow-sm hover:border-indigo-400 flex items-center gap-2 min-w-[90px] justify-between transition-colors">
                    ${cfg.label}
                    <span class="bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-700 px-1 rounded-full text-[9px] ${qtdSelec === 0 ? 'hidden':''}">${qtdSelec}</span>
                    <svg class="w-3 h-3 text-slate-400" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M19 9l-7 7-7-7"></path></svg>
                </button>
                <div id="drop_pre_${cfg.campo}" class="drop-menu-pre hidden absolute left-0 z-50 mt-1 w-64 bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-lg shadow-xl max-h-64 overflow-y-auto">
                    <div class="flex justify-between items-center px-3 py-2 border-b border-slate-100 bg-slate-50 sticky top-0 z-10">
                        <button onclick="marcarTodosFiltro('${cfg.campo}')" class="text-[9px] font-black text-indigo-600 hover:text-indigo-800 uppercase tracking-wider bg-indigo-50 px-2 py-1 rounded">Marcar Todos</button>
                        <button onclick="limparUnicoFiltro('${cfg.campo}')" class="text-[9px] font-black text-slate-500 hover:text-red-500 uppercase tracking-wider bg-white border border-slate-200 px-2 py-1 rounded shadow-sm">Limpar</button>
                    </div>
            `;
            
            unicos.forEach(val => { 
                let checked = selecoesFiltrosPre[cfg.campo].includes(val) ? "checked" : "";
                let corTexto = val === 'VENCIDO' ? 'text-red-600' : (val === 'VENCE HOJE' ? 'text-yellow-600' : 'text-slate-700');
                html += `
                    <label class="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 hover:bg-slate-50 cursor-pointer text-[10px] font-bold ${corTexto} transition-colors border-b border-slate-50 last:border-0">
                        <input type="checkbox" class="rounded text-indigo-600 focus:ring-indigo-500" value="${val}" onchange="toggleCheckFiltroPre('${cfg.campo}', '${val}')" ${checked}>
                        <span class="truncate" title="${val}">${val}</span>
                    </label>
                `; 
            });
            html += `</div></div>`;
        });
        html += `<button onclick="limparFiltrosPre()" class="ml-2 text-slate-400 hover:text-red-500 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase transition-colors">Limpar Todos</button>`;
        container.innerHTML = html;

        if(window.dropdownAbertoPre) {
            let el = document.getElementById(window.dropdownAbertoPre);
            if(el) el.classList.remove('hidden');
        }
    }

    function limparFiltrosPre() {
        camposFiltro.forEach(c => selecoesFiltrosPre[c] = (c === 'envio' ? ['V1'] : []));
        window.dropdownAbertoPre = null;
        desenharFiltrosInteligentes(); aplicarFiltrosInteligentes();
    }

    function aplicarFiltrosInteligentes() {
        let filtroGargalo = document.getElementById('filtroGargaloPre') ? document.getElementById('filtroGargaloPre').value : 'TODAS';

        dadosFiltradosPre = dadosAtivosPre.filter(d => {
            let passa = true;
            cfgFiltrosPre.forEach(cfg => {
                if (selecoesFiltrosPre[cfg.campo].length > 0) {
                    if (!selecoesFiltrosPre[cfg.campo].includes(d[cfg.campo])) passa = false;
                }
            });

            if (passa && filtroGargalo !== 'TODAS') {
                let isEnvioDone = d.dtEnvioReal && String(d.dtEnvioReal).trim().length > 5;
                let isRecDone = d.dtRecBonReal && String(d.dtRecBonReal).trim().length > 5;
                let isApvDone = d.dtApvBonReal && String(d.dtApvBonReal).trim().length > 5;

                if (filtroGargalo === 'ENVIO') {
                    if (isEnvioDone) passa = false; 
                } 
                else if (filtroGargalo === 'REC') {
                    if (!isEnvioDone || isRecDone) passa = false;
                } 
                else if (filtroGargalo === 'APV') {
                    if (!isEnvioDone || !isRecDone || isApvDone) passa = false;
                }
            }

            return passa;
        });

        // RE-RENDERIZAÇÃO INTEGRAL DAS TELAS ATIVAS DE RESUMO, WIP E ADERÊNCIA
        if(visaoAtualPre === 'wip' || visaoAtualPre === 'WIP') {
            renderizarPainelWIP(dadosFiltradosPre);
            atualizarGraficosPrevisao();
        } else if (visaoAtualPre === 'resumo') {
            renderizarResumoExecutivo(dadosFiltradosPre);
        } else {
            renderizarPainelAderencia();
        }
    }

    function renderizarResumoExecutivo(dados) {
        let kpis = { 
            sku: { tot:0, apv:0, envT:0, envP:0, recT:0, recP:0, apvT:0, apvP:0 }, 
            pg:  { tot:0, apv:0, envT:0, envP:0, recT:0, recP:0, apvT:0, apvP:0 } 
        };
        let cG = {}, cM = {};

        dados.forEach(i => {
            let p = i.paginas || 0;
            
            let envDone = i.dtEnvioReal && String(i.dtEnvioReal).trim().length > 5;
            let recDone = i.dtRecBonReal && String(i.dtRecBonReal).trim().length > 5;
            let apvDone = i.dtApvBonReal && String(i.dtApvBonReal).trim().length > 5;

            kpis.sku.tot++; kpis.pg.tot += p;
            if(apvDone) { kpis.sku.apv++; kpis.pg.apv += p; }

            if(i.adEnvio) {
                kpis.sku.envT++; kpis.pg.envT += p;
                if(i.adEnvio.noPrazo) { kpis.sku.envP++; kpis.pg.envP += p; }
            }
            if(i.adRec) {
                kpis.sku.recT++; kpis.pg.recT += p;
                if(i.adRec.noPrazo) { kpis.sku.recP++; kpis.pg.recP += p; }
            }
            if(i.adApv) {
                kpis.sku.apvT++; kpis.pg.apvT += p;
                if(i.adApv.noPrazo) { kpis.sku.apvP++; kpis.pg.apvP += p; }
            }

            let g = i.grafica || "N/A", m = i.un || "N/A";
            if(!cG[g]) cG[g] = { tot:0, apv:0, pEd:0, pGr:0 };
            if(!cM[m]) cM[m] = { tot:0, apv:0, pEd:0, pGr:0 };

            cG[g].tot++; cM[m].tot++;
            if(apvDone) { cG[g].apv++; cM[m].apv++; }

            if (!envDone && i.stEnvio === 'ATRASO') {
                cG[g].pEd++; cM[m].pEd++; 
            } else if (envDone && !recDone && i.stRec === 'ATRASO') {
                cG[g].pGr++; cM[m].pGr++; 
            } else if (recDone && !apvDone && i.stAprov === 'ATRASO') {
                cG[g].pEd++; cM[m].pEd++; 
            }
        });

        const updateRow = (pref, obj) => {
            document.getElementById(pref+'Tot').innerText = window.formatarBR(obj.tot);
            
            const renderHtml = (valNoPrazo, baseRealizada, cor) => {
                let pct = baseRealizada > 0 ? ((valNoPrazo / baseRealizada) * 100).toFixed(1) : 0;
                return `<div class="flex items-end justify-between"><span>${window.formatarBR(valNoPrazo)}</span> <span class="text-sm ${cor} font-black bg-${cor.replace('text-', '')}/10 px-1.5 rounded">${pct}%</span></div>`;
            };
            
            document.getElementById(pref+'Apv').innerHTML = renderHtml(obj.apv, obj.tot, 'text-emerald-600');
            document.getElementById(pref+'Env').innerHTML = renderHtml(obj.envP, obj.envT, 'text-blue-600');
            document.getElementById(pref+'Rec').innerHTML = renderHtml(obj.recP, obj.recT, 'text-indigo-600');
            document.getElementById(pref+'ApvP').innerHTML = renderHtml(obj.apvP, obj.apvT, 'text-violet-600');
        };

        updateRow('kpiSku', kpis.sku);
        updateRow('kpiPg', kpis.pg);

        const renderChart = (ctxId, dataObj) => {
            let labels = Object.keys(dataObj).sort();
            if(window['chart_'+ctxId]) window['chart_'+ctxId].destroy();
            
            window['chart_'+ctxId] = new Chart(document.getElementById(ctxId), {
                type: 'bar',
                data: {
                    labels: labels,
                    datasets: [
                        { label: 'Total Base', data: labels.map(k => dataObj[k].tot), backgroundColor: '#cbd5e1', borderRadius: 4 },
                        { label: 'Aprovados', data: labels.map(k => dataObj[k].apv), backgroundColor: '#10b981', borderRadius: 4 },
                        { label: 'Atraso Editorial', data: labels.map(k => dataObj[k].pEd), backgroundColor: '#ef4444', borderRadius: 4 },
                        { label: 'Atraso Gráfica', data: labels.map(k => dataObj[k].pGr), backgroundColor: '#f59e0b', borderRadius: 4 }
                    ]
                },
                options: { maintainAspectRatio: false, plugins: { legend: { position: 'bottom' } } }
            });
        };

        renderChart('chartResumoGrafica', cG);
        renderChart('chartResumoMarca', cM);

        let tblMarca = {}; let tblGrafica = {}; let tblGeral = {};

        let parseDate = (dStr) => {
            if(!dStr || String(dStr).trim() === "") return null;
            let p = String(dStr).split(" ")[0].split("/");
            if(p.length === 3) return new Date(p[2], p[1]-1, p[0]).getTime();
            return null;
        };

        let fmtDate = (ts) => {
            if(!ts) return "-";
            let d = new Date(ts);
            return d.getDate().toString().padStart(2,'0') + '/' + (d.getMonth()+1).toString().padStart(2,'0') + '/' + d.getFullYear();
        };

        dados.forEach(i => {
            let g = i.grafica || "N/A";
            let m = i.un || "N/A";
            let gm = g + "@@" + m;

            let isApv = i.dtApvBonReal && String(i.dtApvBonReal).trim().length > 5;
            let tsEnvio = parseDate(i.dtEnvioPlan);
            let tsApv = parseDate(i.dtApvBonPlan);
            
            let taAtrasado = (!isApv && (i.stEnvio === 'ATRASO' || i.stRec === 'ATRASO' || i.stAprov === 'ATRASO'));

            let initObj = (l1, l2) => ({ l1: l1, l2: l2, tot: 0, apv: 0, minE: null, maxA: null, atr: 0 });

            if(!tblMarca[m]) tblMarca[m] = initObj(m, "");
            if(!tblGrafica[g]) tblGrafica[g] = initObj(g, "");
            if(!tblGeral[gm]) tblGeral[gm] = initObj(g, m);

            let updateObj = (obj) => {
                obj.tot++;
                if(isApv) obj.apv++;
                if(taAtrasado) obj.atr++;
                if(tsEnvio) { if(obj.minE === null || tsEnvio < obj.minE) obj.minE = tsEnvio; }
                if(tsApv) { if(obj.maxA === null || tsApv > obj.maxA) obj.maxA = tsApv; }
            };

            updateObj(tblMarca[m]);
            updateObj(tblGrafica[g]);
            updateObj(tblGeral[gm]);
        });

        let renderTbl = (dataObj, tbodyId, showDoisLabels = false) => {
            let html = "";
            let arr = Object.values(dataObj).sort((a,b) => b.tot - a.tot);
            
            arr.forEach(r => {
                let pend = r.tot - r.apv;
                let pct = r.tot > 0 ? ((r.apv / r.tot) * 100).toFixed(1) : 0;
                
                let tdLabels = showDoisLabels 
                    ? `<td class="p-2 font-bold text-slate-700 border-r border-slate-100">${r.l1}</td><td class="p-2 font-semibold text-slate-600 border-r border-slate-100">${r.l2}</td>` 
                    : `<td class="p-2 font-bold text-slate-700 border-r border-slate-100">${r.l1}</td>`;
                
                let colorPct = 'text-slate-600';
                let badgeAtraso = r.atr > 0 ? `<span class="text-red-600 font-black ml-1 text-[10px]" title="Itens Atrasados">(${r.atr} atr)</span>` : '';

                html += `<tr class="border-b border-slate-50 hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors">
                    ${tdLabels}
                    <td class="p-2 text-center font-black text-indigo-700 bg-indigo-50/30 border-r border-slate-100">${window.formatarBR(r.tot)}</td>
                    <td class="p-2 text-center font-bold text-emerald-600">${window.formatarBR(r.apv)}</td>
                    <td class="p-2 text-center font-bold text-amber-500 border-r border-slate-100">${window.formatarBR(pend)}${badgeAtraso}</td>
                    <td class="p-2 text-center text-slate-500 text-[10px]">${fmtDate(r.minE)}</td>
                    <td class="p-2 text-center text-slate-500 text-[10px] border-r border-slate-100">${fmtDate(r.maxA)}</td>
                    <td class="p-2 text-right font-black ${colorPct} bg-slate-50">${pct}%</td>
                </tr>`;
            });
            document.getElementById(tbodyId).innerHTML = html || `<tr><td colspan="8" class="p-4 text-center text-slate-400">Nenhum dado encontrado</td></tr>`;
        };

        renderTbl(tblMarca, 'tbodyResumoMarca', false);
        renderTbl(tblGrafica, 'tbodyResumoGrafica', false);
        renderTbl(tblGeral, 'tbodyResumoGeral', true);
    }

    function renderizarPainelWIP(dados) {
        let totSkus = dados.length; let totPags = 0;
        let kpis = { env: {sP:0, pP:0, sH:0, pH:0, sA:0, pA:0}, rec: {sP:0, pP:0, sH:0, pH:0, sA:0, pA:0}, apv: {sP:0, pP:0, sH:0, pH:0, sA:0, pA:0} };
        let grpIdx = {};

        dados.forEach(i => {
            totPags += i.paginas;
            let sEnv = i.stEnvio; let sRec = i.stRec; let sApv = i.stAprov;
            if(sEnv === 'ATRASO') { kpis.env.sA++; kpis.env.pA += i.paginas; } else if(sEnv === 'HOJE') { kpis.env.sH++; kpis.env.pH += i.paginas; } else if(sEnv === 'NO_PRAZO') { kpis.env.sP++; kpis.env.pP += i.paginas; }
            if(sRec === 'ATRASO') { kpis.rec.sA++; kpis.rec.pA += i.paginas; } else if(sRec === 'HOJE') { kpis.rec.sH++; kpis.rec.pH += i.paginas; } else if(sRec === 'NO_PRAZO') { kpis.rec.sP++; kpis.rec.pP += i.paginas; }
            if(sApv === 'ATRASO') { kpis.apv.sA++; kpis.apv.pA += i.paginas; } else if(sApv === 'HOJE') { kpis.apv.sH++; kpis.apv.pH += i.paginas; } else if(sApv === 'NO_PRAZO') { kpis.apv.sP++; kpis.apv.pP += i.paginas; }

            let numIdx = i.indexTiragem || "S/ Chamado"; let unStr = i.un || "-"; let grStr = i.grafica || "-";
            let chaveUnica = `${numIdx}@@${unStr}@@${grStr}`;

            if(!grpIdx[chaveUnica]) {
                grpIdx[chaveUnica] = { 
                    indexStr: numIdx, un: unStr, grafica: grStr, totalSkus: 0, totalPags: 0, maxAtrasoDias: 0,
                    env: {sP:0, pP:0, sH:0, pH:0, sA:0, pA:0}, rec: {sP:0, pP:0, sH:0, pH:0, sA:0, pA:0}, apv: {sP:0, pP:0, sH:0, pH:0, sA:0, pA:0}
                };
            }
            let g = grpIdx[chaveUnica];
            g.totalSkus++; g.totalPags += i.paginas;
            
            if(i.maxAtrasoDias > g.maxAtrasoDias) g.maxAtrasoDias = i.maxAtrasoDias;

            if(sEnv === 'ATRASO') { g.env.sA++; g.env.pA += i.paginas; } else if(sEnv === 'HOJE') { g.env.sH++; g.env.pH += i.paginas; } else if(sEnv === 'NO_PRAZO') { g.env.sP++; g.env.pP += i.paginas; }
            if(sRec === 'ATRASO') { g.rec.sA++; g.rec.pA += i.paginas; } else if(sRec === 'HOJE') { g.rec.sH++; g.rec.pH += i.paginas; } else if(sRec === 'NO_PRAZO') { g.rec.sP++; g.rec.pP += i.paginas; }
            if(sApv === 'ATRASO') { g.apv.sA++; g.apv.pA += i.paginas; } else if(sApv === 'HOJE') { g.apv.sH++; g.apv.pH += i.paginas; } else if(sApv === 'NO_PRAZO') { g.apv.sP++; g.apv.pP += i.paginas; }
        });

        document.getElementById('kpiWipTotal').innerHTML = `${totSkus} <span class="text-lg text-slate-400 font-bold ml-1">/ ${totPags.toLocaleString('pt-BR')}pgs</span>`;
        let fKPI = (skus, pags) => `${skus} <div class="text-[9px] text-slate-400 font-normal mt-0.5">(${pags.toLocaleString('pt-BR')}pgs)</div>`;
        document.getElementById('wipEnvP').innerHTML = fKPI(kpis.env.sP, kpis.env.pP); document.getElementById('wipEnvH').innerHTML = fKPI(kpis.env.sH, kpis.env.pH); document.getElementById('wipEnvA').innerHTML = fKPI(kpis.env.sA, kpis.env.pA);
        document.getElementById('wipRecP').innerHTML = fKPI(kpis.rec.sP, kpis.rec.pP); document.getElementById('wipRecH').innerHTML = fKPI(kpis.rec.sH, kpis.rec.pH); document.getElementById('wipRecA').innerHTML = fKPI(kpis.rec.sA, kpis.rec.pA);
        document.getElementById('wipApvP').innerHTML = fKPI(kpis.apv.sP, kpis.apv.pP); document.getElementById('wipApvH').innerHTML = fKPI(kpis.apv.sH, kpis.apv.pH); document.getElementById('wipApvA').innerHTML = fKPI(kpis.apv.sA, kpis.apv.pA);

        let tbPrin = document.getElementById('tbodyPrincipal'); tbPrin.innerHTML = ""; let tbReen = document.getElementById('tbodyReentradas'); tbReen.innerHTML = "";
        let temPrin = false; let temReen = false;

        let tTd = (o) => {
            let f = (s, p, cor) => s > 0 ? `<span class="${cor}">${s}<span class="text-[8px] text-slate-400 font-normal ml-0.5">${p}p</span></span>` : `<span class="text-slate-300">0</span>`;
            return `${f(o.sP, o.pP, 'text-slate-600 font-bold')} <span class="text-slate-200 mx-1">/</span> ${f(o.sH, o.pH, 'text-yellow-600 font-black')} <span class="text-slate-200 mx-1">/</span> ${f(o.sA, o.pA, 'text-red-600 font-black')}`;
        };

        let countPrin = 1; 
        let countReen = 1;

        Object.keys(grpIdx).sort((a,b) => grpIdx[b].totalSkus - grpIdx[a].totalSkus).forEach(k => {
            let r = grpIdx[k];
            let numChamado = parseInt(r.indexStr.replace(/\D/g, ''), 10);
            let ehReentrada = (!isNaN(numChamado) && numChamado > 5);
            
            let countIndex = ehReentrada ? countReen++ : countPrin++;

            let rowBase = `
                <tr class="hover:bg-slate-50 border-b border-slate-100 transition-colors">
                    <td class="p-3 text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-400 text-center border-r border-slate-100">${countIndex}</td>
                    <td class="p-3 text-[11px] font-black text-slate-700">${r.indexStr}</td>
                    <td class="p-3 text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-500">${r.un}</td>
                    <td class="p-3 text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-500">${r.grafica}</td>
                    <td class="p-3 text-[12px] font-black text-center text-indigo-600 bg-indigo-50/50 border-r border-slate-100">${r.totalSkus} <span class="text-[9px] text-indigo-400 ml-1">(${r.totalPags.toLocaleString('pt-BR')}p)</span></td>
                    <td class="p-3 text-[11px] text-center border-l border-slate-100 whitespace-nowrap">${tTd(r.env)}</td>
                    <td class="p-3 text-[11px] text-center border-l border-slate-100 whitespace-nowrap">${tTd(r.rec)}</td>
                    <td class="p-3 text-[11px] text-center border-l border-slate-100 bg-purple-50/30 whitespace-nowrap">${tTd(r.apv)}</td>
            `;
            
            if(ehReentrada) { 
                let clAtraso = r.maxAtrasoDias > 0 ? `<span class="text-red-600 font-bold">${r.maxAtrasoDias} dias</span>` : `<span class="text-slate-300">-</span>`;
                tbReen.innerHTML += rowBase + `<td class="p-3 text-[11px] text-center border-l border-slate-100 bg-red-50/30 whitespace-nowrap">${clAtraso}</td></tr>`; 
                temReen = true; 
            } else { 
                tbPrin.innerHTML += rowBase + `</tr>`; 
                temPrin = true; 
            }
        });

        if(!temPrin) tbPrin.innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="8" class="p-6 text-center text-xs font-bold text-slate-400">Vazio.</td></tr>`;
        if(!temReen) tbReen.innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="9" class="p-6 text-center text-xs font-bold text-slate-400">Vazio.</td></tr>`;
    }

    function getInicioSemana(dateObj) {
        let d = new Date(dateObj.getTime()); let diaDaSemana = d.getDay();
        d.setDate(d.getDate() - diaDaSemana + (diaDaSemana === 0 ? -6 : 1));
        return d.getDate().toString().padStart(2,'0') + '/' + (d.getMonth()+1).toString().padStart(2,'0');
    }

    function atualizarGraficosPrevisao() {
        let dadosParaGrafico = dadosFiltradosPre;
        let fase = document.getElementById('filtroFaseHist').value; 
        let propDataPlan = fase === 'envio' ? 'dtEnvioPlan' : (fase === 'rec' ? 'dtRecBonPlan' : 'dtApvBonPlan');
        let propStatus = fase === 'envio' ? 'stEnvio' : (fase === 'rec' ? 'stRec' : 'stAprov');

        let agpDia = {}; let agpSemana = {};

        dadosParaGrafico.forEach(i => {
            if (i[propStatus] !== 'CONCLUIDO' && i[propDataPlan] && i[propDataPlan].trim() !== "") {
                let dtDia = i[propDataPlan].split(" ")[0]; 
                let p = dtDia.split('/');
                if(p.length === 3) {
                    let dReal = new Date(p[2], p[1]-1, p[0]); dReal.setHours(0,0,0,0);
                    let dtSem = getInicioSemana(dReal);

                    if (!agpDia[dtDia]) agpDia[dtDia] = { skus: 0, pags: 0 };
                    agpDia[dtDia].skus++; agpDia[dtDia].pags += i.paginas;
                    if (!agpSemana[dtSem]) agpSemana[dtSem] = { pags: 0 };
                    agpSemana[dtSem].pags += i.paginas;
                }
            }
        });

        let sortedDias = Object.keys(agpDia).sort((a,b) => { let [da,ma,ya]=a.split('/'); let [db,mb,yb]=b.split('/'); return new Date(ya,ma-1,da) - new Date(yb,mb-1,db); });
        let sortedSemanas = Object.keys(agpSemana).sort((a,b) => { let [da,ma]=a.split('/'); let [db,mb]=b.split('/'); return new Date(2025,ma-1,da) - new Date(2025,mb-1,db); });

        let optBase = { responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false, plugins: { legend: { display: false }, datalabels: { display: false } }, scales: { x: { grid: { display: false } } } };

        desenharGraficoChartJS('chartSkuDiario', 'bar', { labels: sortedDias, datasets: [{ data: sortedDias.map(k => agpDia[k].skus), backgroundColor: '#6366f1', borderRadius: 4 }] }, optBase);
        desenharGraficoChartJS('chartPagDiario', 'bar', { labels: sortedDias, datasets: [{ type: 'line', data: sortedDias.map(()=>6000), borderColor: '#ef4444', borderDash: [5,5], borderWidth: 2, pointRadius: 0, fill: false }, { data: sortedDias.map(k => agpDia[k].pags), backgroundColor: '#f59e0b', borderRadius: 4 }] }, optBase);
        desenharGraficoChartJS('chartPagSemanal', 'bar', { labels: sortedSemanas.map(k => "Sem. " + k), datasets: [{ type: 'line', data: sortedSemanas.map(()=>30000), borderColor: '#ef4444', borderDash: [5,5], borderWidth: 2, pointRadius: 0, fill: false }, { data: sortedSemanas.map(k => agpSemana[k].pags), backgroundColor: '#10b981', borderRadius: 4 }] }, optBase);
    }
    
    function renderPainelAderenciaCell(p, t) {
        if(t === 0) return `<span class="text-slate-300">-</span>`;
        let perc = p === t ? 100 : Math.floor((p/t)*100);
        let color = perc < 80 ? 'text-red-500' : 'text-emerald-600';
        return `<div class="font-black text-slate-700">${p} <span class="text-[9px] ${color} ml-1">(${perc}%)</span></div>`;
    }

    function renderizarPainelAderencia() {
        let dados = dadosFiltradosPre;
        
        let faseSel = document.getElementById('filtroFaseAderencia').value;
        let metrSel = document.getElementById('filtroMetricaAderencia').value; 

        let kAd = { env: {pT:0, pP:0, rT:0, rP:0}, rec: {pT:0, pP:0, rT:0, rP:0}, apv: {pT:0, pP:0, rT:0, rP:0} };
        let grafPrin = {}, grafReen = {}; let marcPrin = {}, marcReen = {};

        let hoje = new Date(); hoje.setHours(0,0,0,0);
        let datas15 = []; for(let i=14; i>=0; i--) { let d = new Date(hoje); d.setDate(d.getDate()-i); datas15.push(d.getDate().toString().padStart(2,'0')+'/'+(d.getMonth()+1).toString().padStart(2,'0')); }
        let sema7 = []; for(let i=6; i>=0; i--) { let d = new Date(hoje); d.setDate(d.getDate()-(i*7)); sema7.push(getInicioSemana(d)); }
        let meses = ["Jan","Fev","Mar","Abr","Mai","Jun","Jul","Ago","Set","Out","Nov","Dez"];
        let anoAtual = hoje.getFullYear();

        let st15 = {}, st7s = {}, stAn = {};
        datas15.forEach(d => st15[d] = {p:0, f:0});
        st7s.forEach(w => st7s[w] = {p:0, f:0});
        meses.forEach(m => stAn[m] = {p:0, f:0});

        dados.forEach(i => {
            let num = parseInt(String(i.indexTiragem).replace(/\D/g, ''), 10);
            let eR = (!isNaN(num) && num > 5);

            if(i.adEnvio) { eR ? (kAd.env.rT++, i.adEnvio.noPrazo && kAd.env.rP++) : (kAd.env.pT++, i.adEnvio.noPrazo && kAd.env.pP++); }
            if(i.adRec) { eR ? (kAd.rec.rT++, i.adRec.noPrazo && kAd.rec.rP++) : (kAd.rec.pT++, i.adRec.noPrazo && kAd.rec.pP++); }
            if(i.adApv) { eR ? (kAd.apv.rT++, i.adApv.noPrazo && kAd.apv.rP++) : (kAd.apv.pT++, i.adApv.noPrazo && kAd.apv.pP++); }

            let g = i.grafica || "-"; let m = i.un || "-";
            let tg = eR ? grafReen : grafPrin; let tm = eR ? marcReen : marcPrin;
            if(!tg[g]) tg[g] = { t:0, envT:0, envP:0, recT:0, recP:0, apvT:0, apvP:0 };
            if(!tm[m]) tm[m] = { t:0, envT:0, envP:0, recT:0, recP:0, apvT:0, apvP:0 };
            tg[g].t++; tm[m].t++;
            if(i.adEnvio) { tg[g].envT++; tm[m].envT++; if(i.adEnvio.noPrazo){ tg[g].envP++; tm[m].envP++; } }
            if(i.adRec) { tg[g].recT++; tm[m].recT++; if(i.adRec.noPrazo){ tg[g].recP++; tm[m].recP++; } }
            if(i.adApv) { tg[g].apvT++; tm[m].apvT++; if(i.adApv.noPrazo){ tg[g].apvP++; tm[m].apvP++; } }

            let propAd = faseSel === 'envio' ? 'adEnvio' : (faseSel === 'rec' ? 'adRec' : 'adApv');
            let adFoco = i[propAd];
            
            if(adFoco) {
                let valSoma = metrSel === 'sku' ? 1 : i.paginas;
                let pt = adFoco.data.split('/');
                if(pt.length === 3) {
                    let dReal = new Date(pt[2], pt[1]-1, pt[0]); dReal.setHours(0,0,0,0);
                    let dStr = dReal.getDate().toString().padStart(2,'0') + '/' + (dReal.getMonth()+1).toString().padStart(2,'0');
                    if(st15[dStr]) { adFoco.noPrazo ? st15[dStr].p += valSoma : st15[dStr].f += valSoma; }
                    let wStr = getInicioSemana(dReal);
                    if(st7s[wStr]) { adFoco.noPrazo ? st7s[wStr].p += valSoma : st7s[wStr].f += valSoma; }
                    if(dReal.getFullYear() === anoAtual) {
                        let mStr = meses[dReal.getMonth()];
                        if(stAn[mStr]) { adFoco.noPrazo ? stAn[mStr].p += valSoma : stAn[mStr].f += valSoma; }
                    }
                }
            }
        });

        let fPost = (p,t) => {
            if(t === 0) return '-';
            let perc = p === t ? 100 : Math.floor((p/t)*100);
            return `<span class="${perc < 80 ? 'text-red-500' : 'text-emerald-600'}">${perc}%</span>`;
        };

        document.getElementById('adEnvPrinPerc').innerHTML = fPost(kAd.env.pP, kAd.env.pT); document.getElementById('adEnvPrinVol').innerText = `${kAd.env.pP} de ${kAd.env.pT} SKUs`;
        document.getElementById('adRecPrinPerc').innerHTML = fPost(kAd.rec.pP, kAd.rec.pT); document.getElementById('adRecPrinVol').innerText = `${kAd.rec.pP} de ${kAd.rec.pT} SKUs`;
        document.getElementById('adApvPrinPerc').innerHTML = fPost(kAd.apv.pP, kAd.apv.pT); document.getElementById('adApvPrinVol').innerText = `${kAd.apv.pP} de ${kAd.apv.pT} SKUs`;

        document.getElementById('adEnvReenPerc').innerHTML = fPost(kAd.env.rP, kAd.env.rT); document.getElementById('adEnvReenVol').innerText = `${kAd.env.rP} de ${kAd.env.rT} SKUs`;
        document.getElementById('adRecReenPerc').innerHTML = fPost(kAd.rec.rP, kAd.rec.rT); document.getElementById('adRecReenVol').innerText = `${kAd.rec.rP} de ${kAd.rec.rT} SKUs`;
        document.getElementById('adApvReenPerc').innerHTML = fPost(kAd.apv.rP, kAd.apv.rT); document.getElementById('adApvReenVol').innerText = `${kAd.apv.rP} de ${kAd.apv.rT} SKUs`;

        let gerarHtmlTabela = (obj, idTbody) => {
            let keys = Object.keys(obj).sort((a,b) => obj[b].t - obj[a].t);
            if(keys.length === 0) { document.getElementById(idTbody).innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="5" class="p-4 text-center text-xs text-slate-400">Nenhum dado encontrado.</td></tr>`; return; }
            
            let html = "";
            keys.forEach(k => {
                let r = obj[k];
                html += `<tr class="border-b border-slate-50 hover:bg-slate-50">
                    <td class="p-2 font-bold text-slate-700">${k}</td>
                    <td class="p-2 text-center text-slate-500 font-bold bg-slate-50">${r.t}</td>
                    <td class="p-2 text-center border-l border-slate-100">${renderPainelAderenciaCell(r.envP, r.envT)}</td>
                    <td class="p-2 text-center border-l border-slate-100">${renderPainelAderenciaCell(r.recP, r.recT)}</td>
                    <td class="p-2 text-center border-l border-slate-100 bg-purple-50/30">${renderPainelAderenciaCell(r.apvP, r.apvT)}</td>
                </tr>`;
            });
            document.getElementById(idTbody).innerHTML = html;
        };

        gerarHtmlTabela(grafPrin, 'tbAdGrafPrin'); gerarHtmlTabela(grafReen, 'tbAdGrafReen');
        gerarHtmlTabela(marcPrin, 'tbAdMarcPrin'); gerarHtmlTabela(marcReen, 'tbAdMarcReen');

        let filterLabels = (arr, stObj) => arr.filter(k => stObj[k].p + stObj[k].f > 0);
        let lb15 = filterLabels(datas15, st15);
        let lb7s = filterLabels(sema7, st7s);
        let lbAn = filterLabels(meses, stAn);

        let optStacked = { 
            responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false, 
            plugins: { 
                legend: { position: 'bottom' }, 
                datalabels: { color: '#fff', font: { weight: 'bold', size: 9 }, formatter: (v) => v > 0 ? v : '' },
                tooltip: {
                    callbacks: {
                        label: function(context) {
                            let label = context.dataset.label || '';
                            let val = context.raw;
                            let dataIdx = context.dataIndex;
                            let total = 0;
                            context.chart.data.datasets.forEach(d => { total += d.data[dataIdx]; });
                            let perc = total > 0 ? (val === total ? 100 : Math.floor((val / total) * 100)) : 0;
                            return `${label}: ${val} (${perc}%)`;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }, 
            scales: { x: { stacked: true, grid: { display: false } }, y: { stacked: true } } 
        };

        desenharGraficoChartJS('chartAd15d', 'bar', {
            labels: lb15,
            datasets: [ { label: 'No Prazo', data: lb15.map(d=>st15[d].p), backgroundColor: '#10b981', borderRadius: 2 }, { label: 'Atrasado', data: lb15.map(d=>st15[d].f), backgroundColor: '#ef4444', borderRadius: 2 } ]
        }, optStacked);

        desenharGraficoChartJS('chartAd7s', 'bar', {
            labels: lb7s.map(w=>"S. "+w),
            datasets: [ { label: 'No Prazo', data: lb7s.map(w=>st7s[w].p), backgroundColor: '#10b981', borderRadius: 2 }, { label: 'Atrasado', data: lb7s.map(w=>st7s[w].f), backgroundColor: '#ef4444', borderRadius: 2 } ]
        }, optStacked);

        desenharGraficoChartJS('chartAdAno', 'bar', {
            labels: lbAn,
            datasets: [ { label: 'No Prazo', data: lbAn.map(m=>stAn[m].p), backgroundColor: '#10b981', borderRadius: 2 }, { label: 'Atrasado', data: lbAn.map(m=>stAn[m].f), backgroundColor: '#ef4444', borderRadius: 2 } ]
        }, optStacked);
    }

    function desenharGraficoChartJS(canvasId, tipo, data, customOptions) {
        let ctx = document.getElementById(canvasId).getContext('2d');
        if (graficosAtivosPre[canvasId]) graficosAtivosPre[canvasId].destroy();
        graficosAtivosPre[canvasId] = new Chart(ctx, { type: tipo, data: data, options: customOptions, plugins: [ChartDataLabels] });
    }

    document.addEventListener('click', function(event) {
        if (!event.target.closest('#containerFiltrosPreProd')) {
            document.querySelectorAll('.drop-menu-pre').forEach(m => m.classList.add('hidden'));
            window.dropdownAbertoPre = null;
        }
    });

    // ==========================================
    // MÓDULO DE CAIXAS (ATUALIZADO: CONSOLIDADO INCLUÍDO E OC REMOVIDA)
    // ==========================================
    window.filtrosCxIniciados = false;
    window.caixasExportarGlobais = [];
    window.listasMultiCx = {
        'Fornecedor': new Set(), 'Marca': new Set(), 'Movimentação': new Set(), 
        'Envio': new Set(), 'Status': new Set(), 'Local Ent.': new Set(),
        'St Prontidão': new Set(), 'St Coleta': new Set(), 'St Entrega': new Set()
    };
    window.mapCamposCx = {
        'Fornecedor': 'Fornecedor de saída', 'Marca': 'Marca', 'Movimentação': 'Produção ou Movimentação',
        'Envio': 'Envio', 'Status': 'Status solicitação', 'Local Ent.': 'Local de Entrega',
        'St Prontidão': '_stProntPlan', 'St Coleta': '_stColPlan', 'St Entrega': '_stEntPlan'
    };

    window.toggleFilterMenuCx = function(idCat, event) {
        if(event) event.stopPropagation();
        let menu = document.getElementById(`menu-cx-${idCat}`);
        document.querySelectorAll('.menu-filtro-cx').forEach(m => m.classList.add('hidden'));
        if(menu) menu.classList.remove('hidden');
    };
    window.checkAllCx = function(idCat, checkStatus) {
        document.querySelectorAll(`.chk-cx-${idCat}`).forEach(cb => cb.checked = checkStatus);
        window.renderTabelaCaixas();
    };
    window.checkOnlyCx = function(idCat, valToKeep) {
        document.querySelectorAll(`.chk-cx-${idCat}`).forEach(cb => cb.checked = (cb.value === valToKeep));
        window.renderTabelaCaixas();
    };
    window.limparFiltrosCx = function() {
        let inputBusca = document.getElementById('buscaCaixas'); if(inputBusca) inputBusca.value = '';
        let dIni = document.getElementById('fCxDtIni'); if(dIni) dIni.value = '';
        let dFim = document.getElementById('fCxDtFim'); if(dFim) dFim.value = '';
        document.querySelectorAll('input[class*="chk-cx-"]').forEach(cb => cb.checked = true);
        window.renderTabelaCaixas();
    };

    document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        if(!e.target.closest('.filtro-container-cx')) { 
            document.querySelectorAll('.menu-filtro-cx').forEach(m => m.classList.add('hidden')); 
        }
    });

    window.carregarDadosCaixas = function(force = false) {
        if(window.setLoading) window.setLoading(true, "Carregando Base de Caixas...");
        google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(dados => { try { if(typeof dados === "string" && (dados.trim().startsWith("[") || dados.trim().startsWith("{"))) dados = JSON.parse(dados); if(typeof dados === "string") dados = JSON.parse(dados); } catch(e){} 
            window.DADOS_CAIXAS_CACHE = dados;
            window.filtrosCxIniciados = false; 
            window.renderTabelaCaixas();
            if(window.setLoading) window.setLoading(false);
            if(force) showToast("Base de Caixas updated successfully!");
        }).withFailureHandler(e => {
            if(window.setLoading) window.setLoading(false);
            alert("Erro ao carregar caixas: " + e.message);
        }).getDadosCaixas();
    };

    window.exportarCaixasCSV = function() {
        if (!window.caixasExportarGlobais || window.caixasExportarGlobais.length === 0) {
            alert("Nenhum dado filtrado para exportar."); return;
        }
        // Cabeçalho CSV atualizado
        let c = "\uFEFFConsolidado;Fornecedor;Marca;Código;Descrição;Local Entrega;Quantidade;Status;St Prontidão;St Coleta;St Entrega;Dt Entrega (Plan);Dt Entrega (Real);NF\n";
        window.caixasExportarGlobais.forEach(i => {
            c += `${i.consolForn};${i.forn};${i.marca};${i.cod};${i.desc};${i.loc};${i.qtd};${i.status};${i.stPront};${i.stCol};${i.stEnt};${i.dtPlan};${i.dtReal};${i.nf}\n`;
        });
        let a = document.createElement("a"); 
        a.href = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([c], {type:'text/csv;charset=utf-8;'})); 
        a.download = `Acompanhamento_Caixas_${new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}.csv`; 
        a.click();
    };

    window.renderTabelaCaixas = function() {
        if(!window.DADOS_CAIXAS_CACHE) return;

        let hoje = new Date(); hoje.setHours(0,0,0,0);
        let hojeIso = hoje.toISOString().split('T')[0];

        let calcStatusPrazo = (dtPlan, dtReal) => {
            if (dtReal && dtReal !== "null" && /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(dtReal)) {
                if (dtPlan && dtPlan !== "null" && /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(dtPlan)) {
                    if (dtReal > dtPlan) return "Concluído Fora do Prazo";
                    else return "Concluído no Prazo";
                }
                return "Concluído";
            }
            if (!dtPlan || dtPlan === "null" || !/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(dtPlan)) return "S/ Data"; 
            
            let p = dtPlan.split('-');
            let d = new Date(p[0], p[1]-1, p[2]);
            d.setHours(0,0,0,0);
            let diff = Math.ceil((d.getTime() - hoje.getTime()) / 86400000);
            
            if (diff < 0) return "Em atraso";
            if (diff <= 7) return "Próximos 7 dias";
            return "No prazo";
        };

        let safeIso = (raw) => {
            if (!raw || String(raw).trim() === "") return null;
            let str = String(raw).trim();
            let iso = typeof extrairDataISO === "function" ? extrairDataISO(str) : null;
            if (iso) return iso;
            let splitT = str.split("T")[0];
            if (/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(splitT)) return splitT;
            return str;
        };

        if (!window.filtrosCxIniciados) {
            Object.keys(window.listasMultiCx).forEach(k => window.listasMultiCx[k].clear());
            
            window.DADOS_CAIXAS_CACHE.forEach(l => {
                let prPlan = safeIso(l["Prontidão planejada"]);
                let prReal = safeIso(l["Prontidão real"]);
                let colPlan = safeIso(l["Coleta planejada"]);
                let colReal = safeIso(l["Coleta realizada"]);
                let entPlan = safeIso(l["Entrega planejada"]);
                let entReal = safeIso(l["Entrega realizada"]);

                l._stProntPlan = calcStatusPrazo(prPlan, prReal);
                l._stColPlan = calcStatusPrazo(colPlan, colReal);
                l._stEntPlan = calcStatusPrazo(entPlan, entReal);

                Object.keys(window.mapCamposCx).forEach(k => {
                    let val = String(l[window.mapCamposCx[k]] || "").trim();
                    if(!val || val === "undefined" || val === "-") val = "(Vazio)"; 
                    window.listasMultiCx[k].add(val);
                });
            });

            let container = document.getElementById('containerFiltrosMultiCx');
            let htmlFiltros = "";
            Object.keys(window.listasMultiCx).forEach(key => {
                let idCat = key.replace(/\s+/g, '').replace('.', ''); 
                htmlFiltros += `
                <div class="relative filtro-container-cx z-[60]">
                    <button id="btn-filtro-cx-${idCat}" onclick="window.toggleFilterMenuCx('${idCat}', event)" class="bg-white border border-slate-300 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50 flex items-center gap-1 shadow-sm uppercase tracking-wide transition-colors">
                        ${key} <span class="text-[8px] opacity-60">▼</span>
                    </button>
                    <div id="menu-cx-${idCat}" class="menu-filtro-cx hidden absolute left-0 top-[calc(100%+4px)] bg-white border border-slate-200 shadow-xl rounded-xl w-60 p-2">
                        <div class="flex justify-between items-center mb-2 pb-2 border-b border-slate-100">
                            <button onclick="window.checkAllCx('${idCat}', true)" class="text-[9px] font-bold text-emerald-600 hover:underline px-1 py-0.5">Marcar Todos</button>
                            <button onclick="window.checkAllCx('${idCat}', false)" class="text-[9px] font-bold text-red-600 hover:underline px-1 py-0.5">Desmarcar</button>
                        </div>
                        <div class="max-h-48 overflow-y-auto scroller space-y-1 pr-1">
                            ${Array.from(window.listasMultiCx[key]).sort().map(val => `
                                <div class="flex justify-between items-center hover:bg-slate-50 p-1 rounded border border-transparent hover:border-slate-100 group/item">
                                    <label class="flex items-start gap-2 text-[10px] cursor-pointer font-semibold text-slate-700 flex-1">
                                        <input type="checkbox" value="${val}" class="chk-cx-${idCat} mt-0.5" checked onchange="window.renderTabelaCaixas()">
                                        <span class="whitespace-normal leading-tight">${val}</span>
                                    </label>
                                    <button onclick="window.checkOnlyCx('${idCat}', '${val}')" class="hidden group-hover/item:block text-[8px] bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded font-bold border border-indigo-100">Único</button>
                                </div>
                            `).join('')}
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>`;
            });
            if(container) container.innerHTML = htmlFiltros;
            window.filtrosCxIniciados = true;
        }

        const getSelectedCx = (idCat) => new Set(Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(`.chk-cx-${idCat}:checked`)).map(cb => cb.value));
        let selFilters = {};
        Object.keys(window.listasMultiCx).forEach(k => { 
            let idCat = k.replace(/\s+/g, '').replace('.', '');
            selFilters[k] = getSelectedCx(idCat); 
            let btn = document.getElementById(`btn-filtro-cx-${idCat}`);
            if (btn) {
                if (selFilters[k].size < window.listasMultiCx[k].size) {
                    btn.classList.add('bg-indigo-50', 'border-indigo-400', 'text-indigo-800');
                    btn.classList.remove('bg-white', 'border-slate-300', 'text-slate-700');
                } else {
                    btn.classList.add('bg-white', 'border-slate-300', 'text-slate-700');
                    btn.classList.remove('bg-indigo-50', 'border-indigo-400', 'text-indigo-800');
                }
            }
        });

        let busca = document.getElementById('buscaCaixas') ? document.getElementById('buscaCaixas').value.toLowerCase().normalize("NFD").replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "") : "";
        let fDtIni = document.getElementById('fCxDtIni').value;
        let fDtFim = document.getElementById('fCxDtFim').value;
        
        let kpis = { tot: 0, prod: 0, ent: 0, atr: 0, volTot: 0, volProd: 0, volEnt: 0, volAtr: 0 };
        let adr = {
            pront: { reqTot: 0, volTot: 0, reqOk: 0, volOk: 0 },
            colet: { reqTot: 0, volTot: 0, reqOk: 0, volOk: 0 },
            entre: { reqTot: 0, volTot: 0, reqOk: 0, volOk: 0 }
        };

        window.caixasExportarGlobais = [];
        let html = "";

        const badgeColor = (st) => {
            if(st === "S/ Data") return "bg-slate-100 text-slate-500 border-slate-200";
            if(st === "Em atraso") return "bg-red-100 text-red-700 border-red-200";
            if(st === "Próximos 7 dias") return "bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 border-amber-200";
            if(st === "Concluído no Prazo") return "bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-700 border-indigo-200";
            if(st === "Concluído Fora do Prazo") return "bg-fuchsia-100 text-fuchsia-700 border-fuchsia-200";
            if(st === "Concluído") return "bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-700 border-indigo-200";
            return "bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 border-emerald-200"; 
        };

        window.DADOS_CAIXAS_CACHE.forEach(c => {
            let matchAll = true;
            Object.keys(selFilters).forEach(k => {
                let valPlanilha = String(c[window.mapCamposCx[k]] || "").trim();
                if(!valPlanilha || valPlanilha === "undefined" || valPlanilha === "-") valPlanilha = "(Vazio)"; 
                if (!selFilters[k].has(valPlanilha)) matchAll = false;
            });
            if (!matchAll) return;

            let dtFormIso = typeof extrairDataISO === "function" ? extrairDataISO(c["Data de formalização"]) : (c["Data de formalização"] ? String(c["Data de formalização"]).split("T")[0] : null);
            if (fDtIni && dtFormIso && dtFormIso < fDtIni) return;
            if (fDtFim && dtFormIso && dtFormIso > fDtFim) return;

            let consolForn = String(c["Consolidado fornecedores"] || "").trim(); // NOVA COLUNA
            let forn = String(c["Fornecedor de saída"] || "").trim();
            let marca = String(c["Marca"] || "").trim();
            let cod = String(c["Código"] || "").trim();
            let desc = String(c["Descrição"] || "").trim();
            let loc = String(c["Local de Entrega"] || "").trim();

            let textoBusca = `${cod} ${desc} ${forn} ${consolForn} ${marca}`.toLowerCase().normalize("NFD").replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "");
            if (busca !== "" && !textoBusca.includes(busca)) return;

            let qtd = window.arredondar(c["Quantidade"]);
            let status = String(c["Status solicitação"] || "-").trim();
            let stLow = status.toLowerCase();
            
            let dtEntPlan = safeIso(c["Entrega planejada"]);
            let dtEntReal = safeIso(c["Entrega realizada"]);
            let dtProntPlan = safeIso(c["Prontidão planejada"]);
            let dtProntReal = safeIso(c["Prontidão real"]);
            let dtColPlan = safeIso(c["Coleta planejada"]);
            let dtColReal = safeIso(c["Coleta realizada"]);
            
            kpis.tot++; kpis.volTot += qtd;
            let taAtrasado = false;

            let realIsDate = dtEntReal && /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(dtEntReal);

            if (stLow.includes("entregue") || stLow.includes("concluid") || realIsDate) {
                kpis.ent++; kpis.volEnt += qtd;
                status = status === "-" ? "Entregue" : status;
            } else {
                kpis.prod++; kpis.volProd += qtd;
                if (dtEntPlan) {
                    let planIsDate = /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(dtEntPlan);
                    if (!planIsDate || dtEntPlan < hojeIso) { 
                        kpis.atr++; kpis.volAtr += qtd; taAtrasado = true; 
                    }
                }
            }

            const evalPrazo = (plan, real, obj) => {
                let hasPlan = plan && plan !== "null" && plan !== "-";
                let hasReal = real && real !== "null" && real !== "-";
                if (!hasPlan && !hasReal) return; 

                obj.reqTot++; obj.volTot += qtd;
                let isNoPrazo = false;
                let planIsDate = hasPlan && /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(plan);
                let realIsDate = hasReal && /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(real);

                if (hasPlan && !planIsDate) isNoPrazo = false;
                else if (hasReal && !realIsDate) isNoPrazo = false;
                else if (realIsDate && planIsDate) isNoPrazo = real <= plan; 
                else if (realIsDate && !hasPlan) isNoPrazo = true; 
                else if (!hasReal && planIsDate) isNoPrazo = plan >= hojeIso; 
                
                if (isNoPrazo) { obj.reqOk++; obj.volOk += qtd; }
            };

            evalPrazo(dtProntPlan, dtProntReal, adr.pront);
            evalPrazo(dtColPlan, dtColReal, adr.colet);
            evalPrazo(dtEntPlan, dtEntReal, adr.entre);

            let formatarDT = (val) => {
                if(!val || val === "null") return "-";
                if (/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(val)) {
                    let p = val.split('-'); return `${p[2]}/${p[1]}/${p[0]}`;
                }
                return val;
            };
            
            let nf = String(c["NF de faturamento"] || "-").trim();
            let corStatus = stLow.includes("entregue") || stLow.includes("conclui") ? "bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 border border-emerald-200" : (taAtrasado ? "bg-red-100 text-red-800 border border-red-300" : "bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 border border-amber-200");

            window.caixasExportarGlobais.push({
                consolForn, forn, marca, cod, desc: String(desc).replace(/;/g, ","), loc, qtd, status, 
                stPront: c._stProntPlan, stCol: c._stColPlan, stEnt: c._stEntPlan, 
                dtPlan: formatarDT(dtEntPlan), dtReal: formatarDT(dtEntReal), nf
            });

            html += `<tr class="border-b border-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors">
                <td class="p-2 font-black text-[10px] text-indigo-700 bg-slate-50 border-r border-slate-100">${consolForn || "-"}</td>
                <td class="p-2 font-bold text-slate-700 border-r border-slate-100">${forn || "-"}</td>
                <td class="p-2 border-r border-slate-100"><span class="font-bold">${marca || "-"}</span><br><span class="text-[8px] text-slate-500">${loc}</span></td>
                <td class="p-2 border-r border-slate-100"><span class="font-bold text-indigo-700">${cod || "-"}</span><br><span class="text-[8px] text-slate-500 truncate max-w-[150px] block" title="${desc}">${desc}</span></td>
                <td class="p-2 text-right font-black text-slate-700 bg-slate-50 border-r border-slate-100">${window.formatarBR(qtd)}</td>
                <td class="p-2 text-center border-r border-slate-100"><span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded shadow-sm text-[9px] font-bold ${corStatus}">${status}</span></td>
                
                <td class="p-2 text-center border-r border-slate-100"><span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded shadow-sm text-[9px] font-bold border ${badgeColor(c._stProntPlan)}">${c._stProntPlan}</span></td>
                <td class="p-2 text-center border-r border-slate-100"><span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded shadow-sm text-[9px] font-bold border ${badgeColor(c._stColPlan)}">${c._stColPlan}</span></td>
                <td class="p-2 text-center border-r border-slate-100"><span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded shadow-sm text-[9px] font-bold border ${badgeColor(c._stEntPlan)}">${c._stEntPlan}</span></td>

                <td class="p-2 text-center font-mono font-bold text-amber-700 bg-amber-50/30 border-r border-slate-100">${formatarDT(dtEntPlan)}</td>
                <td class="p-2 text-center font-mono font-bold text-emerald-700 bg-emerald-50/30 border-r border-slate-100">${formatarDT(dtEntReal)}</td>
                <td class="p-2 text-center font-mono font-bold text-slate-600">${nf}</td>
            </tr>`;
        });

        const upKpi = (id, reqs, vols) => {
            let el = document.getElementById(id);
            if(el) el.innerHTML = `${window.formatarBR(reqs)} <span class="block text-[10px] font-bold opacity-60 mt-0.5 tracking-wider uppercase">Vol: ${window.formatarBR(vols)}</span>`;
        };
        upKpi('kpiCxTotal', kpis.tot, kpis.volTot);
        upKpi('kpiCxProd', kpis.prod, kpis.volProd);
        upKpi('kpiCxEnt', kpis.ent, kpis.volEnt);
        upKpi('kpiCxAtr', kpis.atr, kpis.volAtr);
        
        document.getElementById('tbCaixasCorpo').innerHTML = html || `<tr><td colspan="12" class="p-4 text-center font-bold text-slate-400">Nenhum pedido atende aos filtros.</td></tr>`;

        const renderBlockAdr = (title, objAdr, icon) => {
            let pR = objAdr.reqTot > 0 ? ((objAdr.reqOk / objAdr.reqTot) * 100).toFixed(1) : 0;
            let pV = objAdr.volTot > 0 ? ((objAdr.volOk / objAdr.volTot) * 100).toFixed(1) : 0;
            let colorReq = pR >= 90 ? 'text-emerald-600' : (pR >= 70 ? 'text-amber-500' : 'text-red-500');
            let colorVol = pV >= 90 ? 'text-emerald-600' : (pV >= 70 ? 'text-amber-500' : 'text-red-500');

            return `
            <div class="bg-slate-50 rounded-xl p-4 border border-slate-200">
                <div class="flex items-center gap-2 mb-3">
                    <span class="text-xl">${icon}</span>
                    <h4 class="text-[10px] font-black text-slate-600 uppercase tracking-widest leading-tight">${title}</h4>
                </div>
                <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                    <div>
                        <p class="text-[9px] font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase mb-0.5">Por Pedidos</p>
                        <p class="text-2xl font-black ${colorReq} leading-none">${objAdr.reqTot > 0 ? pR + '%' : '-'}</p>
                        <p class="text-[9px] font-semibold text-slate-500 mt-1">${window.formatarBR(objAdr.reqOk)} de ${window.formatarBR(objAdr.reqTot)}</p>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                        <p class="text-[9px] font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase mb-0.5">Por Volume (Qtd)</p>
                        <p class="text-2xl font-black ${colorVol} leading-none">${objAdr.volTot > 0 ? pV + '%' : '-'}</p>
                        <p class="text-[9px] font-semibold text-slate-500 mt-1">${window.formatarBR(objAdr.volOk)} de ${window.formatarBR(objAdr.volTot)}</p>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>`;
        };

        let adrHtml = renderBlockAdr("Prontidão Produção", adr.pront, "🏭");
        adrHtml += renderBlockAdr("Coleta das Caixas", adr.colet, "🚛");
        adrHtml += renderBlockAdr("Entrega no Destino", adr.entre, "📍");
        document.getElementById('containerAderenciaCaixas').innerHTML = adrHtml;
    };
</script>
